rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; triage .transcription/triage/2025/rprop.json: all 66 in-scope values agree; the 2 differences are returns the project refuses (project refuses 2: personal property at rprop.personal, nonresidential property placed in service before 1994 at rprop.early_nonres; rprop note), which the reply depreciates (5-year half-year property, ACRS). Within scope both multiply column (c) by the Table A-6 / A-7a rate (p946 p. 73).

Ruling: scope; triage 18/20 agree; the two differences are project refusals: the reply also depreciates personal property by the 5-year GDS table, which the project refuses (rprop.personal, i4562 p. 9, Lines 19a Through 19j); on buildings both take the Table A-6 / A-7a mid-month rate by month and recovery year (p946 pp. 73-74).

Ruling: representation; i4562 p. 12, Column (g)—Depreciation deduction: the project multiplies rprop.basis by the Table A rate. The candidate reaches the same amount through its own h_figured helper; its 13 completed-return differences come from reading rprop.qip as an input where the project computes it (rprop.qip_if_new_nonres, i4562 p. 10), so the candidate is unknown on records the project answers. No value difference on a completed return; the 1 refusal is the project's cited rprop.personal screen. Triage executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/rprop.json): 228 of 289 comparisons agree, 226 of 286 in scope. Project stands.
